description: Use this when the user asks who the top Polymarket traders are by profit or by trading volume, or for a Polymarket leaderboard — for example "top Polymarket traders this month", "highest-profit traders this week", "highest-volume traders this week", or "top politics traders by realized profit". Returns up to 25 traders (default 10) from Polymarket.com's public leaderboard: rank, full wallet address, public display name, profit in USD for the period, and dollar trading volume, with a PredictionScan profile link for each trader. Periods: day (since 00:00 UTC), week (7 days), month (30 days) or all-time. Day/week/month profit counts open positions at current prices; all-time profit is realized only. Category boards (sports, politics, crypto, economics, finance, tech, culture, esports, weather, mentions) rank within that category; Polymarket does not publish per-category dollar volume, so it is null there. Read-only; past results do not predict future results. Do not use this to choose a market or trader for the user to put money in; it reports data only. Do not call this when the user asks which market to buy or how to make a profit.

category.description: Limit the board to one market category. Omit for all markets

metric.description: Rank by 'profit' (USD gained in the period) or 'volume' (amount traded). Default 'profit'

period.description: Time window: 'day' (since 00:00 UTC), 'week' (7 days), 'month' (30 days) or 'all' (all-time). Default 'month'

name: get_leaderboard
title: Get trader leaderboard
